Roth.mapped_det_ne_zero_aux✝.{u_2} {τ : Type u_2} {R : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ} {l : ℕ} {D : Fin l → τ →₀ ℕ}
  {U : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} {V : Polynomial ℤ} (hU : U ≠ 0) (hV : V ≠ 0)
  (hF :
    (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) R).det =
      (rename some) U * (Polynomial.aeval (X none)) V) :
  (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦
        (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R)).det ≠
    0

private theorem Roth.mapped_det_ne_zero_aux.{u_2} : ∀ {τ : Type u_2} {R : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℤ} {l : ℕ}
  {D : Fin l → τ →₀ ℕ} {U : MvPolynomial τ ℤ} {V : Polynomial ℤ},
  U ≠ 0 →
    V ≠ 0 →
      (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) R).det =
          (rename some) U * (Polynomial.aeval (X none)) V →
        (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦
              (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R)).det ≠
          0 :=
fun {τ} {R} {l} {D} {U} {V} hU hV hF ↦
  have hmapdet :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a ↦
            _a =
              (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦
                  (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν))
                    ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R)).det)
          (RingHom.map_det (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
            (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) R))))
      ((fun {n} {inst inst_1} ↦
          @Eq.ndrec (DecidableEq n) inst
            (fun {inst_2} ↦
              ∀ [inst_3 : Fintype n] {R : Type u_2} [inst_4 : CommRing R] (M M_1 : Matrix n n R),
                M = M_1 → M.det = M_1.det)
            (fun [Fintype n] {R} [CommRing R] M M_1 e_M ↦ e_M ▸ Eq.refl M.det) inst_1 (Subsingleton.elim inst inst_1))
        ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)).mapMatrix
          (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) R))
        (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦
          (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R))
        (Matrix.ext fun μ ν ↦
          of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congr
                (congrArg Eq
                  (congrArg (fun x ↦ x μ ν)
                    (RingHom.mapMatrix_apply (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
                      (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) R))))
                (congrFun'
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg (⇑Matrix.of)
                      (funext fun μ ↦
                        funext fun ν ↦
                          hasseDeriv_map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν) R))
                    μ)
                  ν))
              (eq_self
                ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
                  ((hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) R))))));
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≠ 0) (Eq.symm hmapdet)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a)
          (ne_eq
            ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ))
              (Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ (hasseDeriv (Finsupp.mapDomain some (D μ) + Finsupp.single none ↑ν)) R).det)
            0)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ¬_a)
            (propext
              (map_eq_zero_iff (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) (map_injective (Int.castRingHom ℝ) Int.cast_injective)))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ¬_a = 0) hF))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ¬_a) (propext mul_eq_zero)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a) (propext not_or)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ¬_a ∧ ¬(Polynomial.aeval (X none)) V = 0)
                    (propext (map_eq_zero_iff (rename some) (rename_injective some (Option.some_injective τ))))))
                ⟨hU,
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ¬_a = 0) (Roth.aeval_X_eq_rename none V)))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ¬_a)
                          (propext
                            (map_eq_zero_iff (rename fun x ↦ none)
                              (rename_injective (fun x ↦ none) fun a b x ↦ Subsingleton.elim a b)))))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ¬_a)
                            (propext
                              (map_eq_zero_iff (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ Unit).symm
                                (AlgEquiv.injective (uniqueAlgEquiv ℤ Unit).symm)))))
                        hV))⟩))))))
